observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 console standing upright on a black tufted surface, with a white DualSense controller in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a slightly different angle, with the same controller in front.
The console has the PlayStation logo on the top left corner.
The controller is white with black grips and buttons, matching the console's color scheme.
The background is a wooden slatted wall, and the console is placed on a black cushioned surface.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos.
No power cord, cables, or accessories are shown.
No model number or serial number is visible on the console or controller in the photos.

claims.claim: Ps5 console fat uk used with 1 pad
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a white PlayStation 5 console with a DualSense controller, matching the 'fat' design and '1 pad' claim. The 'UK used' claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number on the back of the console or a screenshot of the console's system information.
risks.if_unproven: priced with a discount for potential legal or warranty issues

risks.risk: Console may be missing accessories (power cord, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the serial number.
Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and responding to inputs.
Photo of all included accessories (power cord, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
